WITH f AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND channel_code='ST'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id)=1),
fraw AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) raw_net, count(*) raw_rows FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND f.channel_code='ST' GROUP BY 1),
sales AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) net_nostaff, count(*) rows_dedup FROM f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net, count(*) nret, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nret_d FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
rp AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, count(*) days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(sales.store_id, ret.store_id, rp.store_id) store_id, fraw.raw_rows, sales.rows_dedup, fraw.raw_net, net_all, net_nostaff, ret_net, nret, nret_d, rpt_before, rpt_ret, rpt_net, days
FROM sales FULL JOIN ret USING(store_id) FULL JOIN rp USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN fraw ON fraw.store_id=coalesce(sales.store_id, ret.store_id, rp.store_id) ORDER BY 1

  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id)=1),
fraw AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) raw_net, count(*) raw_rows FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND f.channel_code='ST' GROUP BY 1),
sales AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) net_nostaff, count(*) rows_dedup FROM f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (SELECT s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net, count(*) nret, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nret_d FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
rp AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rpt_before, sum(returns_net) rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) rpt_net, count(*) ndays FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(sales.store_id, ret.store_id, rp.store_id) store_id, fraw.raw_rows, sales.rows_dedup, fraw.raw_net, net_all, net_nostaff, ret_net, nret, nret_d, rpt_before, rpt_ret, rpt_net, ndays

WITH p AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=5),
sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS gross_net
  FROM (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f, p WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 AND f.channel_code='ST'
        QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.etl_loaded_at, f.sales_line_id)=1) f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key, p
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sales.gross_net - coalesce(ret.refunds,0) DESC) AS rank,
       p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, d.store_id, d.store_name,
       sales.gross_net - coalesce(ret.refunds,0) AS net_sales
FROM sales LEFT JOIN ret USING(store_id)
JOIN (SELECT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) d USING(store_id), p
WHERE sales.store_id < 900
ORDER BY rank
